title: 헌법재판소 정보화심의위원회 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00429:20210322:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM <No. 429, March 22, 2021>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Rules)
(1) Part of the Rules on Protection of Personal Information of the Constitutional Court shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2, "Constitutional Court Informatization Promotion Committee" shall be replaced with "Constitutional Court Information System Deliberation Committee."
In Article 3, "Informatization Promotion Committee" shall be replaced with "Information System Deliberation Committee."
In Article 12 (3), "Constitutional Court Informatization Promotion Committee" shall be replaced with "Constitutional Court Information System Deliberation Committee."
(2) Part of the Rules on the Administrative Organization of the Constitutional Court shall be amended as follows:
In Article 10 (8), "Informatization Promotion Committee" shall be replaced with "Information System Deliberation Committee."
